blk_part_06_part_6_same_needs_different_.text: Put the five places side by side with the lens. The human needs are the same everywhere: weather, food, work or school, and weekend plans. The place changes what comes first and how long it lasts. On the New York City subway, weather is about a wet walk, and the talk lasts seconds. In a London cafe queue, weather is the polite opening, and the talk lasts a minute. In a Madrid plaza, food and family fill an evening. In a Berlin office kitchen, work and coffee fill a short break. In a Paris bakery line, bread fills the moment. Fast, tight, task places make short practical talk. Slow, open, social places make long personal talk. If you know the place and the pace, you can guess the topic.
